end.summary:
Named cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere through examples.
Matched everyday objects such as dice, laddoo, cake tin and ice-cream cone to 3D shapes.
Identified a cylinder in different positions using its circular ends and curved side.
The screen did not display an object during one prompt; no shape misconception was recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the five 3D shapes using familiar objects and their features, such as square faces, circular ends and curved sides. Ishita explained that a cylinder stays a cylinder when it is standing or lying down, and used examples like dice, laddoo and an ice-cream cone. The object prompt could not be attempted because the screen was blank; there was no shape mix-up to correct later. At home, ask them to find and name one cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere around the house.
